description: This file defines React components related to viewing test files and their summaries within a web-based test report interface. It includes components for displaying a list of test files, handling their expanded/collapsed state, showing report metadata, and header elements with project and timing information.

methods.name: TestFilesView
methods.description: React functional component that renders a list of test files with expand/collapse functionality and handles filtering based on number of tests.

methods.name: TestFilesHeader
methods.description: React functional component that renders the header section of the test files report, showing project info, timing, metadata toggle, and errors.
